renew_loan.reason: No verified renewal request endpoint; the registered action stays disabled and the default plan is an official-page handoff.

outputs: seat and room plans persist the 4.3 read precheck states (selection/availability/eligibility/fees/rules/preparation) without checked_at so a replay cannot change the digest
a seat row with an unknown or unmapped status, a changed map control, a non-unique same-name seat or a missing seat rule becomes OFFICIAL_SEAT_SELECTION/CONFIRM_SEAT_RULES instead of a write
a room whose duration rule is missing stays in RULE_UNVERIFIED: the plan hands off CONFIRM_ROOM_DURATION_RULE instead of treating the room as unlimited or closed
room cancel reads the selected device's live resvRule even when no booking window was selected (find_room(for_booking=False) no longer requires FREE_TIME_ONLY)
seat cancel re-verifies the official detail (number/state/location/start/end), the current status and the area cancellation rule before dispatch
room cancel checks applicant, date, status, uuid, members and the live cancelTime window before dispatch
a cancelled seat/room record that disappears from the own list is success only when the platform also accepted the request; otherwise the state stays UNKNOWN
renew_loan binds one own loan id, its current due_at, renew flag and hints; preparation reads eligibility only and never sends a renewal request

renewal success requires the same loan id to return from a complete own-loan read with a strictly later due_at; the bound due_at is never rewritten and the new value only appears as platform.new_due_at
a lost or failed renewal response stays UNKNOWN, marks automatic_resend=false and repeated execute only reconciles

the renewal contract is an explicit frozen SourceContract (empty production registry, SYNTHETIC evidence in tests); the exact POST is bound to origin, main frame, body hash, success field and one gate capability
library result previews keep the title/member values out of the public shape; the encrypted journal retains the bound subject for local confirmation
reconciled library results link to the todo refresh query of the same source (library.seat/library.room/library.loans) and date window

full_offline_suite_linux.evidence_tree: this worktree with a read-only node_modules link; the link is not committed

verified_cases: a seat map control change after prepare rejects the old plan with FAILED and sends zero requests
an unmapped/unknown seat state becomes OFFICIAL_SEAT_SELECTION and ends in AWAITING_OFFICIAL with zero requests
a room with a missing duration rule hands off CONFIRM_ROOM_DURATION_RULE and never dispatches
a room cancel reads the live cancelTime rule when the read has no selected booking window
a seat or room record outside the current account and a seat id used as a room cancel are rejected before dispatch
an empty seat cancel list without a platform receipt stays UNKNOWN on execute and on later result() calls
renewal eligibility is read only: prepare sends nothing, NOT_ELIGIBLE and OVERDUE are rejected, unknown eligibility hands off
a renewal response that fails or is lost keeps the original due_at, stays UNKNOWN and repeats only reconciliation
the same loan with the same due_at is not success; a strictly later due_at on the same loan becomes SUCCEEDED with platform.new_due_at
a repeated, short or page-disagreeing loan read never prepares or reconciles a renewal
four concurrent executes of one renewal plan send at most one request
the exact renewal wire rejects a changed body, wrong method, wrong frame and a second use of the gate
with THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 new renewal plans are blocked while an existing UNKNOWN plan still reconciles; THU_LIBRARY_WRITE=0 blocks new plans and keeps readback
limits: Offline synthetic verification only: no real seat, room or renewal read or write was performed.

Renewal execution is BLOCKED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE: the source registry marks library.renewal PARTIAL and no verified request endpoint exists. The registered renew_loan contract is enabled=false; production can only produce an official-page handoff until 2.3/1.1 freezes a verified contract.
6.1 must register the renewal adapter on ('library','renew_loan'); this module does not edit the MCP/CLI wiring owned by 6.1.
Renewal binds the Primo loan record id; the active-loan read does not expose a separate copy/item id.
Pending seat/room plans created before this module persist a business object without the precheck summary, so they re-prepare instead of executing. They fail closed; no write is replayed.
The room precheck summary is per read; the plan stores the selected room's axes plus the read selection state.
Renewal cannot be undone on the platform; the module never invents a reverse operation or cancels other loans.
Windows DPAPI execution was not re-run for this module; the Linux offline suite and the shared action framework's platform tests are the evidence here. The batch regression re-runs both platforms.
rollback: Set THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 to stop new renewal plans (reconciliation keeps working), or THU_LIBRARY_WRITE=0 to stop all library writes while reads and pending results stay available. Reverting the code removes the renewal package and the precheck summary from new plans; keep action journals and platform evidence, never delete UNKNOWN/PENDING records, and do not treat local cleanup as a remote cancellation or renewal.
